title: Understand Fractions
goal: I can count all equal pieces for the denominator and colored pieces for the numerator.
catchAll: Find one whole. Count all equal pieces for the bottom number; count colored pieces for the top.

teacher.def: The denominator of a fraction tells how many equal parts are in the whole. It is the bottom part of the fraction
A unit fraction is ONE part of a whole. It always has a numerator of one.
The numerator of a fraction tells how many equal parts are being described. It is the top part of the fraction.
A fraction is a number used when a whole is split into equal parts.

glossary.whole: one complete shape including colored and plain pieces
glossary.fraction: a number that names equal parts of a whole
glossary.denominator: bottom number: all equal parts in one whole
glossary.numerator: top number: the equal parts being described
glossary.unitFraction: a fraction with a numerator of 1

text: This complete strip is one whole, even when only some pieces are colored.

screens.title: Equal pieces give the part size

screens.title: Write the top count

screens.title: More than one piece can be selected
text: Now three of the same four equal pieces are colored.
Write 3/4: the denominator stays 4, but the numerator becomes 3.

text: This disk has six equal pieces, and two are colored.

text: One of eight equal pieces is colored: 1/8.
A fraction with numerator 1 is a unit fraction.
